import React from 'react'; export const PrivacyPolicyView = ({ onNavigateHome }) => { return (
{/* Header Breadcrumb & Title */}
Legal & Compliance Last Updated: September 18, 2026

CampusBridge Privacy Policy

Your privacy is paramount. This Privacy Policy outlines how the CampusBridge platform collects, uses, protects, and handles institutional student and alumni member data.

{/* Main Content Box */}
{/* Section 1 */}

1. Institutional Data Collection

CampusBridge is designed exclusively for verified members of Bannari Amman Institute of Technology (BIT). To ensure platform integrity and verify alumni credentials, we collect:

  • Student Information: Official University Roll Number, full name, institutional email address (@bitsathy.ac.in), academic department, degree programme, and graduation batch year.
  • Alumni Information: Graduation batch year, department, current employer, job designation, verified LinkedIn profile URL, and industry specializations.
  • Profile & Mentorship Records: Profile photographs, technical interest domains, mentorship availability slots, session bookings, and feedback ratings.
{/* Section 2 */}

2. AI Resume Analysis & Gemini Processing

When students utilize the AI Resume Analyzer workspace:

  • Resume files (PDF format) are processed using server-side Google Gemini 2.5 Pro multimodal analysis solely to extract technical competencies, projects, and career domain alignment.
  • Resume contents are processed ephemerally for the immediate purpose of generating feedback, keyword gap analysis, and tailored alumni mentor recommendations.
  • User resumes are never sold, rented, or utilized for commercial ad targeting.
{/* Section 3 */}

3. Purpose of Data Processing

All collected personal and academic information is processed strictly to:

  • Authenticate user identity against authorized BIT campus registry records.
  • Facilitate high-value, verified 1-on-1 mentorship pairings between students and experienced alumni.
  • Notify members of upcoming mentorship calls, referral opportunities, and institutional career announcements.
  • Maintain institutional safety, prevent impersonation, and uphold community standards.
{/* Section 4 */}

4. Cookies & Local Analytics

CampusBridge utilizes privacy-friendly first-party browser cookies and local storage tokens strictly to maintain secure login sessions (campusbridge_token), user UI preferences (such as light/dark mode theme), and aggregated navigation analytics to improve site performance. We do not use intrusive third-party cross-site advertising trackers.

{/* Section 5 */}

5. Contact University Alumni Relations Cell

If you have questions regarding this privacy policy, your personal data stored on CampusBridge, or wish to request data correction or account deletion, please contact:

Alumni Relations & Career Development Cell

Bannari Amman Institute of Technology

Sathyamangalam, Erode District, Tamil Nadu – 638401, India

Email: alumni@bitsathy.ac.in | Phone: +91 (4295) 226000

); };

import React from 'react'; export const TermsAndConditionsView = ({ onNavigateHome }) => { return (
Platform Terms Last Updated: September 18, 2026

CampusBridge Terms and Conditions

Please review the terms of service governing participation, mentorship interactions, and platform conduct within the CampusBridge alumni engagement network.

{/* Main Terms Box */}
{/* Section 1 */}

1. Platform Eligibility & Verification

CampusBridge is a closed, institutional platform. Access is restricted to current bona fide students, verified alumni, and faculty coordinators of Bannari Amman Institute of Technology. All account registrations are subject to automated format verification and manual administrator review before reaching fully verified status. Providing false academic credentials or misrepresenting employment history constitutes immediate grounds for account revocation.

{/* Section 2 */}

2. Mentorship Code of Conduct

All mentorship interactions, messaging, resume evaluations, and mock interview video meetings must maintain the highest standards of professionalism and institutional mutual respect:

  • Punctuality: Both students and mentors agree to honor scheduled mentorship appointments. If rescheduling is necessary, minimum 24 hours advance notice is required.
  • Constructive Focus: Guidance must be centered on career growth, technical upskilling, resume critiques, and interview preparation.
  • Harassment Zero Tolerance: Any form of discrimination, inappropriate communication, harassment, or solicitation will result in permanent ban and institutional disciplinary action.
{/* Section 3 */}

3. Referrals and Job Postings

Alumni post job openings and internal employee referral opportunities voluntarily in good faith. Submitting an application or referral request does not guarantee employment or an interview. Alumni maintain complete discretion over internal candidate referrals according to their employer’s official HR policies.

{/* Section 4 */}

4. Non-Commercial Voluntary Nature

CampusBridge is a non-commercial educational initiative. Mentors volunteer their personal time without monetary compensation. Charging fees or soliciting monetary payments for mentorship, resume reviews, or referrals through CampusBridge is strictly prohibited.

{/* Section 5 */}

5. Limitation of Liability & Contact

Bannari Amman Institute of Technology and the CampusBridge administrative team do not warrant that all advice or employment tips provided by mentors will result in placement. Inquiries concerning these terms should be directed to the CampusBridge platform administrator:

CampusBridge Administration Office

Bannari Amman Institute of Technology, Sathyamangalam – 638401

Email: admin.campusbridge@bitsathy.ac.in
